Name: Seasonal Improved Leo
Author: zilchaz
Description:
After Leo moves to Pelican Town, he changes his outfits!

This mod changes Leo's outfits [u][b]after his 6 hearts event[/b][/u] to seasonal outfits when he is [u]on the mainland[/u].
Also in vanilla, Leo won't talk with you at Spirit's Eve. This mod changes his dialogue slightly, so you can see his portrait.
